author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices the five-finger home, steps and skips, counting three and four, and how lines end, while you and your child play an old tune together.

classes.title: Find your five-finger home
classes.goal: Hear the song and rest one finger on each of the five home keys.

mathTarget.parentLine: Using the two black keys to find where the hand lives

classes.parentPrompt: Point to the two black keys, then help your child rest the thumb on C.
classes.childAction: Find the two black keys, put your thumb on C.
classes.bridge: C is the front door, left of the two black keys; five fingers, five rooms.

intro.caption: First we sway, then we find C
intro.parentCue: sway together and hum the tune

games.caption: One finger, one key
games.parentCue: Say the finger numbers together, one to five

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding the five-finger home on the keys.

classes.title: Down the stairs to C
classes.goal: Play the first line, walking down from finger 3 to the thumb.

mathTarget.parentLine: Counting down in order, like stairs: three, two, one

classes.parentPrompt: Say 'three, two, one' as your child plays; walk your fingers down their arm.
classes.childAction: Fingers three, two, one walk down the stairs to C.
classes.bridge: Each step left is one stair down; the thumb on C is the floor.

intro.caption: Down the stairs we go
intro.parentCue: Walk your fingers down your child's arm

games.caption: Three, two, one: down to C
games.parentCue: Count down the finger numbers out loud

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: walking down the keys in order.

classes.title: Three Es in a row
classes.goal: Play the third line and spot the three Es in a row at the end.

mathTarget.parentLine: Seeing and hearing 'three' at once, without counting one by one

classes.parentPrompt: Hold up three fingers before the Es, and count them together as they come.
classes.childAction: Play G, G, F, then E, E, E: count three!
classes.bridge: The tune starts on the tallest key, steps down, then sits on E three times.

intro.caption: Three Es in a row
intro.parentCue: Hold up three fingers for the three Es

games.caption: G, G, F, then three Es
games.parentCue: Count one, two, three on the Es

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: seeing and counting three.

classes.title: Which line goes home?
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly and notice which lines land on C.

mathTarget.parentLine: Some lines end at home on C, one line does not

classes.parentPrompt: After each line, ask: did it land home on C? Cheer when it does.
classes.childAction: Play each line; pat your lap when it lands on C.
classes.bridge: C is home; three lines come home, one line stops on E and waits.

intro.caption: Listen for the line that goes home

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing how each line ends.

classes.title: Little step, little skip
classes.goal: Practise the second line slowly, where D skips over E to F.

mathTarget.parentLine: Moving to the next key, or jumping over one key

classes.parentPrompt: Point to E and say 'skip over it' as finger 2 hands off to finger 4.
classes.childAction: Play D, D, skip to F, then step down home.
classes.bridge: A step goes next door; a skip jumps over one key, like a puddle.

intro.caption: Watch slowly
intro.parentCue: Point to E: this is the key we skip

games.caption: D, D, skip to F
games.parentCue: Say 'skip!' on F, then 'step, step, step'

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: telling a step from a skip.

classes.title: Four beats, slow and even
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly, counting four beats in each bar.

mathTarget.parentLine: Beats come in groups of four: one, two, three, four

classes.parentPrompt: Tap your child's shoulder on each beat and count 1, 2, 3, 4 softly.
classes.childAction: Play slowly and evenly while you count to four together.
classes.bridge: Each bar is a little train car with four seats, one beat per seat.

intro.caption: Four beats, slow and even
intro.parentCue: Count one to four softly on the beats

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: counting four beats in a bar.

classes.title: Goose low, goslings high
classes.goal: Move the hand to a higher C and play the song with the same fingers.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same song and fingers, moved to a higher home

classes.parentPrompt: Help your child find the next C to the right, then ask which sounds nicer.
classes.childAction: Move your hand up to high C and play the same notes.
classes.bridge: Same hand shape, a new house to the right: the goslings' high voices.

intro.caption: Watch: same song, up high
intro.parentCue: Find the next two black keys to the right

games.caption: Goslings sing up high
games.parentCue: Use a tiny voice to sing along

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: moving a song to a new place.

classes.title: Hurry, go tell!
classes.goal: Play the whole song along with the music and keep going.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping your playing in time with the music

classes.parentPrompt: Sing the words along and nod on each beat; if a note slips, keep going.
classes.childAction: Play with the music and keep going to the end.
classes.bridge: Hurry down the road with the news: keep walking, never stop.

intro.caption: Play along
intro.parentCue: Sing the words softly with your child

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping in time with the music.

classes.title: A story song for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy, gently, from first note to last.

mathTarget.parentLine: A song has a start, a middle and an end

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; announce the song, then clap and bow together.
classes.childAction: Bow, play gently for teddy, then bow again.
classes.bridge: Play it gently, like telling teddy a quiet story.

intro.caption: A song for teddy
intro.parentCue: Sit teddy in front and announce the song

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song gently, start to end.
